author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: एवं ज्ञानं प्रशस्य तस्यांतरङ्गसाधनं फलं चाह ॥ श्रद्धावानिति ।  आस्तिक्यबुद्धिमान्-मत्परो मदेकनिष्ठः संयतेन्द्रियो जितेन्द्रियश्च ज्ञानं लभते।  ज्ञानं लब्ध्वा परां शांतिं मोक्षमचिरेणाविलंबेनाधिगच्छति प्राप्नोति असति प्रारब्धे। सति तु तस्मिन् तद्भोगानांतरमिति ॥ ४.३९॥
translation:
He who is full of faith and is devoted to Me alone and has mastery over his senses, obtains wisdom, and ere long thereafter attains Moksha (supreme bliss.) (39) 
V. Ere Long thereafter: if there be no Prârabdha Karma, he at once obtains release; but, if it remains, he does, after exhausting it by experience. (39)
A. If knowledge and the means of knowledge are absent, naturally wrong notions would step in and the Lord points out the consequence of the latter.
